title: Upholstering, Scouting, Hobbies — Jim Elk family feature
text:
TOGETHERNESS WORKS IN PHYSICISTS' FAMILY — Their dad works professionally in the exciting world of NASA, but the family of Jim Elk, who visits in Bonham often, all work together in hobbies of upholstering and Scouting. Mr. and Mrs. Elk, center, are shown with Gary, 3½, on his dad's lap, and Denita, 6, and Bruce, 8. Standing left to right are James, 15, Leslie, 11, and Lee, 12.
(Favorite Photo)

notes: Photo shows Jim Elk and wife with six children: Gary (3½), Denita (6), Bruce (8), James (15), Leslie (11), Lee (12). Jim Elk works for NASA. Article headline 'Upholstering, Scouting, Hobbies' visible at bottom; body text of article not shown in clipping.
